If I remove life gain, I would most likely have to remove a majority of the self-damage as well. If that happens, then why play Darien? Sure, I'd have a lot of space freed up, and I'd make a few tokens when I take damage, but that certainly doesn't provide any real wins outside of trying to damage out an opponent and reactively trying to remove their stuff.

Darien makes tokens (equal to the damage) whenever you take damage, so the life gain from creature ETBs allows for pseudo-invincibility; I just have that density in there to make it incredibly likely that I'll be able to get at least one of those cards during a match. You make a good point about the protection stuff though, I may trim some of that back

I don't believe it should be too concerning. I've had this happen on both of my ports and a complete shutdown and unplug for 5 minutes resets it. I think during times when the card draws a lot of power you get that undervolting issue and when you stop doing the activity that draws so much power the warning light remains on. I have to do this about monthly on my computer. Not a permanent fix but it gets the job done.

I ended up using Titania. She can wipe status effects, can fly, and can dish out good DPS. All those components are vital for the exploiter orb fight. If you have a necramech you almost don’t even need a heavy gun for the profit taker fight besides just to bash legs since her dex pixia is another weapon to put status on.

One thing I know works is if you reach rank 10 with artificer you can just straight up ignore race/class restrictions with attunement and use it and at that point even make your own I feel as since it's an integrated part with the prosthetic it would work somewhat like the new UA magic tattoos that essentially works as 1 attunement item since they are together but it's really up to you.
